# Copilot instructions

Always follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Before making any change in this repository, read `.github/skills/urlovingly-workspace/SKILL.md` in full. After any change that alters files, routes, database tables, environment variables, commands, plans, behaviour or decisions, update that file in the same change and add a line to its change log. Then run `python -m pytest -q`.
